title: Books Re Chiang Kai Shek & Pro Waung Ching

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
S. B. M.C.
Memorandum.
No. S. B. D. 1951.
POLICE FORCE.
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
30.
Shanghai, 22 . 11 . 1930
To O / Special Branch

Sir
The books were received
by post in the Central
Register addressed to the
Commr of Police are for
attached label.
The S.C.I has the postage
stamps.

Yours
SI
For attention please
J.P.S. 22/11

"These books were
handed to me by D.S.
Cole.
They are anti Chiang Kai
Shek & pro - Wang Ching
Wei propaganda literature
but not Communistic.

J. Gage

Reg.
Is any information
available as to where
these books came from?
JPS
page_data.zh:
上海工部局
S. B. M.C.
备忘录。
编号 S. B. D. 1951。
警务处。
工部局。
30.
上海，1930年11月22日
致 特别处主任 / 特别处

先生：
寄至中央登记处并写明由警察总监收讫的书籍已收到，标签附后。
特别调查科（S.C.I）持有邮票。

此致
SI
请予关注
J.P.S. 11月22日

“这些书籍是由副巡官（D.S.）科尔（Cole）交给我的。
它们是反蒋介石及亲汪精卫的宣传文献，但并非共产主义性质。

J. Gage

登记员注：
是否有情报显示这些书籍来自何处？
JPS
